rules: Never merge held='florida-approval' and held='aama-tested' into one list or one filter label.
Never render a uFactor or soundStcOitc that is absent - show thermalNote instead. Never write 'NFRC'.
Wherever an opening with waterLimited=true shows designPressure, show waterResistance beside it.
hvhz is per opening, not per system. Only badge openings where opening.hvhz is true.
designPressure varies per opening. If one system-level number is shown, prefix it 'up to'.
A null or missing field means no data exists. Omit the row - never render a dash or a zero.

copy.headline: Hurricane certified, inside the strictest zone in the country
copy.paragraph: ConceptSystem 77 is Florida approved for large and small missile impact both inside and outside the High Velocity Hurricane Zone — Miami-Dade and Broward — at ±65 psf. Fixed lights to 94½ by 141¾ inches, casement and tilt & turn to 48 by 96⁷⁄₁₆. Triple glazing takes the U-factor to 0.18 and the wall to STC 43.
points: Approved in and outside the HVHZ

systems.name: MasterLine 8
systems.certification: Florida Product Approval FL47832, FL47833, FL47834, FL47835, FL47836

copy.headline: A complete impact range, from fixed light to front door
copy.paragraph: MasterLine 8 is Florida approved across six products — fixed, tilt & turn, casement, awning, entrance door and terrace door — every one large and small missile rated for Wind Zone 3. Fixed lights reach 162 inches tall. The system is the quietest in the range at STC 50, and reaches a U-factor of 0.16 triple glazed.

copy.headline: Impact rated sliding, one to four tracks
copy.paragraph: MasterPatio is the Florida approved impact slider — XO, XXP, XXO and XXXX from one to four tracks, at ±60 psf, with panels to 84 by 150 inches and glass units up to 2½ inches thick. Large and small missile rated for Wind Zone 3.

copy.headline: Lift & slide, certified for Miami-Dade
copy.paragraph: ConceptPatio 155 is the lift & slide door approved for the High Velocity Hurricane Zone at ±65 psf, large missile rated. The panel lifts clear of its seals before it travels, so very heavy glass — up to 3,306 lbs on a fixed panel — moves with one hand and seals tightly when lowered.

copy.headline: Impact rated curtain wall
copy.paragraph: ConceptWall 50 is Florida approved curtain wall for Wind Zone 3, at 60 psf glass load with 15 psf water resistance and air infiltration of 0.02 cfm/ft². Pressure plate, structurally glued and structurally clamped variants, with mullion depths to 11¹³⁄₁₆ inches and triple glazing to a U-factor of 0.14.

copy.headline: Hurricane certified, in vinyl
copy.paragraph: Vision Guard is our impact-certified vinyl window, approved by the State of Florida for use inside and outside the High Velocity Hurricane Zone. Rated to ±65 psf and tested against a 9 lb timber missile at Wind Zone 4, Missile Level D, with SentryGlas laminated glazing that holds the pane in its frame even when it breaks. Picture windows to 59 by 98 inches, tilt & turn to 48 by 78.
